question: Which statement about the American colonies before 1763 is most accurate?

options.C: Parliament had regularly collected direct taxes from the colonists
options.D: Every colony was governed directly by officials elected in England

trap.how_to_avoid: Recall that colonial assemblies existed long before 1763 and held powers over local taxes.
